per_question_scores.question_text: string — the interview question that was asked
per_question_scores.answer_summary: string — brief summary of the student's answer

scores.concrete_example: integer 1-5 — did the student provide a specific, real example?
scores.star_structure: integer 1-5 — did the answer follow STAR structure (Situation, Task, Action, Result)?
scores.link_to_job: integer 1-5 — did the student connect their experience to the target role?
scores.quantifiable_outcome: integer 1-5 — did the student include measurable results or impact?

dimensions.concrete_example: float — average across all answered questions, rounded to 1 decimal
dimensions.star_structure: float — average across all answered questions, rounded to 1 decimal
dimensions.link_to_job: float — average across all answered questions, rounded to 1 decimal
dimensions.quantifiable_outcome: float — average across all answered questions, rounded to 1 decimal

overall_scores.total: float — average of the four dimension averages, rounded to 1 decimal

question_count: integer — number of questions actually scored (1 to 6)
readiness_label: string — one of: 'Interview ready' (4.3-5.0), 'Strong foundation' (3.5-4.2), 'Developing well' (2.8-3.4), 'Needs more practice' (2.0-2.7), 'Needs clearer examples' (1.0-1.9)
strengths: string — specific praise with direct quotes or references from the conversation
improvements: string — specific, actionable improvement advice tied to scoring dimensions
contextual_advice: string — advice referencing unused resume experiences or job competency gaps from analyst_output

interview_metadata.candidate_level: string — passed through from input (e.g. student_intern)
interview_metadata.status: completed | ended_early — passed through from input
interview_metadata.completion_reason: all_questions_completed | user_ended_early — passed through from input
